Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu orders, table reservation, aur popular North Indian dishes showcase kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dhaba1986

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:

"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"

"Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservations, and highlighting your authentic North Indian menu near Income Tax Chauraha. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
